data.name: aweXpect0002Description
data.value: The method object.Equals is not supported for the expectations. You should use "IsEqualTo" instead!

data.name: aweXpect0003Description
data.value: Directly after "Throws" the expectation continues the sentence "throws a …", so it must use the nested "With…" vocabulary. The "Has…" vocabulary starts a standalone sentence about an exception and belongs after ".Which" (or on an exception subject). Using it directly after "Throws" produces an ungrammatical failure message.

data.name: aweXpect0003MessageFormat
data.value: Replace "{0}" with "{1}" or insert ".Which" before it

data.name: aweXpect0003ReplaceCodeFixTitle
data.comment: The title of the code fix that renames to the With… twin.

data.name: aweXpect0003InsertWhichCodeFixTitle
data.comment: The title of the code fix that inserts .Which before the expectation.

data.name: aweXpect0005Description
data.value: An async lambda that is converted to a void-returning delegate returns before the expectation is evaluated, so a failing expectation is thrown on an unrelated thread after the test has completed instead of failing the test. Pass a delegate that returns a task, or await the expectation in the test method itself.

data.name: aweXpect0005MessageFormat
data.value: Expectations in an async void lambda are not observed by the test

data.name: aweXpect0005Title
data.value: Expectations in an async void lambda are not observed by the test
